violations.text: Raw animal foods (such as chicken) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as chicken) in the flip top prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Tofu and chicken were observed held at 47-60 degrees Fahrenheit in the flip top prep unit. Per PIC, foods were placed in the prep unit 2 hours prior to inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods moved to freezer to rapidly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

The 2-door flip top prep unit was observed in poor repair (maintaining ambient temperature above 41 degrees Fahrenheit). Unit to not be used to store any TCS foods until it can be replaced/repaired/serviced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Raw animal foods (such as eggs and beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as veggies) in the flip top prep unit and walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Foods move to proper locations by PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2024

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. At the time of inspection, a service was requested to repair the dish machine. Establishment allowed to use dishwasher to WASH ONLY and sanitize at the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) was observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener moved to ware-washing area to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2024
The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked (beef pho). Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/17/2023

The non-food contact surfaces below were observed to have an accumulation of dust, food residue, and other debris. 1) The fan in the walk-in cooler observed with an accumulation of dust 2) The fan of the front sliding door cooler observed with an accumulation of dust 3) The interior of the cookline prep unit observed with an accumulation of food debris 4) The shelving in the walk-in cooler observed with an accumulation of food debris Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2024
